text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This documents out lines the check list 
 I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 at the 
 titled block.
The first draft was initiated by eng. Alsayed Abdel Monem AlGeddawy and tested 
on the feeder no. 15 at 
Fifth Urban Community Substation at 20 March 2002 Cairo Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
 and masks are necessary
Switch off DC source
Environmental Precautions
Before start cleaning, wear 
breathing mask to protect lung tissues from dust particles and chemical solvent 
which, if exist, expose lungs to danger
Don't throw oil or grease 
on ground, collect it and send to central labs to recycle it.
Don't burn clothes used in cleaning, collect it and send to dumb
Tools and Equipment
Suitable 
 tool set
Pieces of 
 clothes and rags
Grease and 
 cleaning liquid (like gasoline)
Helmet, 
 safe shoes and masks
Work to be Carried Out
Clean 
 porcelain insulators of the circuit breaker from dust, dirties, deposits 
 ....etc
Inspect well 
 the flower contacts and check it to be in good condition
Check 
 contact arm to be fixed well and in exact horizontal position
Inspect the 
 pressure of SF6 gas and check it to be in the safe area (green area)
Clean the 
 Socket by video cleaner
Check the 
 mechanism of the circuit breaker, clean it with gas and grease it
Retighten 
 bolts and screws
Switch on 
 and off, 
 the circuit breaker in test position mechanically and electrically
Oiling the 
 wheels of breaker tracks to make it easily move
